component.culprit: Teardown ordering violated: prod removal requires the final backup push verified before deletion; the last verified backup is stale and prod mutated since.
component.measured: last verified backup: 6d ago (snap_prod_daily_047); prod ops since: 3
component.remedy: run 'capcli sys backup --push' to land and verify the final backup, then re-run 'capcli env remove prod' (the out-of-band challenge signature gate still applies)
lines: Teardown ordering violated: backup first, revoke identities second,
dump state third, remove envs last. The final prod backup push
is unverified; deletion is refused until it lands.
